units.source_text: 我以前就在家聽到過一些澀田的傳聞，由於我向來對別人的事情不感興趣，所以對其中的詳情一概不知。

en.t: I had heard a few rumors about Shibuta at home before, but since I have never been interested in other people’s affairs, I knew nothing at all about the details.

units.source_text: 可是，這位小夥子的眼神總讓我奇妙地聯想到魚眼珠，或者說不定他真的就是比目魚的私生子……

en.t: And yet the young man’s eyes always strangely made me think of fish eyes, and perhaps he really was Flounder’s illegitimate child after all...

units.source_text: 如果真是這樣，他倆可真是一對孤寂的父子。

en.t: If that were true, the two of them really were a lonely father and son.

units.source_text: 夜深人靜時，他們父子倆常常瞞著二樓的我，一聲不吭地吃著外賣送來的蕎麥麵什麼的。

en.t: Late at night, when everything was quiet, the father and son would often hide it from me upstairs and silently eat soba or something they had ordered in.

units.source_text: 在比目魚家裡，一直是這個小夥子做飯。

en.t: In Flounder’s house, it was always this young man who did the cooking.
